# gitmoap_group_labels (Data Source)

List the labels a scope defines. Returns every label the group itself defines, in alphabetical order of key. Labels defined by the groups above it are not included. Anyone who can see the group's work items may list them — on a public group, without signing in.

The token needs `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_labels" "platform" {
  group_id = gitmoap_group.platform.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Autocomplete fragment — keeps labels whose key or description contains it, ignoring case

### Read-Only

- `group_labels` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_labels))

<a id="nestedatt--group_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_labels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `title` (String) Its display name, free to change; absent when it shows its key.
